what: T1 level sides are put in name order again, not counted back
from: return compareTeamRows(order, a, b) || countback(a, b) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name);

what: T2 sides level on the figure share the place whatever the countback says
T3 a net tie between sides is broken on gross again
from: return a.toPar - b.toPar || valueOnBasis(basis, a) - valueOnBasis(basis, b);
to: return a.toPar - b.toPar || compareOnBasis(basis, a, b);

what: T4 a side's countback reads the gross card on a net round
T5 the team board numbers the sides itself again (the sweep's own target)
to: const places = placeTexts(placesByValue(rows, (r) => teamPlaceValue(basis, r), (r) => r.played > 0));
